question: An engineer needs to make an XML backup of Cisco UCS Manager. The backup should be transferred using an authenticated and encrypted tunnel, and it should contain all system and service profiles configuration. Which command must be implemented to meet these requirements?
theory: The Cisco UCS Manager CLI backup command syntax is 'create backup <uri> <backup-type>', not 'copy running-config' or 'create file' (which are not valid backup verbs in this context). Because the requirement calls for all system and service profile settings, the type must be 'all-configuration' (the XML export covering both system and logical configuration), and because the transfer must be authenticated and encrypted, the URI must use the scp:// protocol rather than ftp/tftp, giving 'create backup scp://... all-configuration'. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Configuration Management, CLI Backup Commands)
